tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Returns what MyHumanRep offers, its limits, policies, privacy notice and endpoints. No credentials needed.

tools.name: start_conversation
tools.description: Sends a pseudonymous first inquiry to a human reviewer. Returns conversation_id and conversation_token. The token is shown ONCE and cannot be recovered: store it. A reply is not guaranteed and nothing is executed automatically.

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: Returns messages and status for your conversation. Pass next_cursor as "after" to fetch only newer messages. Poll no more than once per minute.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Adds a message to your conversation. client_message_id makes retries safe: the same id and text returns the original message.

tools.name: request_human_capability
tools.description: Submits an open-ended description of something you need a human to do, observe, judge or create. Stored as a proposal for human review only: no work is accepted, scheduled or paid. category_hint is optional and any value is accepted.

tools.name: list_capability_requests
tools.description: Returns the review status and owner notes for this conversation's capability requests.

tools.name: close_conversation
tools.description: Closes your conversation. It cannot be reopened by you; start a new conversation to continue later.

tools.name: discover_human_capabilities
tools.description: Lists all human capabilities you can inquire about (20 canonical services plus aliases), with truthful readiness: inquiry_available vs fulfillment_available. No credentials needed. Unlisted needs are welcome too.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Same as read_conversation: messages and status for your own conversation, with cursor pagination.

tools.name: describe_human_need
tools.description: Describe anything you need a human for, in your own words (objective or problem_statement). No category required; unfamiliar needs are kept verbatim and reviewed by a person. Nothing is booked or paid.

tools.name: get_capability_request_status
tools.description: Review status, classification and owner notes for your conversation's requests. Never includes internal notes.

tools.name: request_human_observation
tools.description: Ask a person to observe real-world conditions somewhere (Human World Oracle). Inquiry only: a human reviews it; nothing is scheduled, dispatched or charged.

tools.name: request_independent_witness
tools.description: Ask for an independent human witness of a permitted event (Human Witness). Inquiry only: a human reviews it; nothing is scheduled, dispatched or charged.

tools.name: request_sensory_report
tools.description: Ask willing people to describe texture, taste, smell, sound or atmosphere (Human Senses). Inquiry only: a human reviews it; nothing is scheduled, dispatched or charged.

tools.name: request_experiment_feasibility
tools.description: Ask whether a nonhazardous physical test or prototype is feasible (Human Laboratory). Feasibility review only. Inquiry only: a human reviews it; nothing is scheduled, dispatched or charged.

tools.name: request_human_dialogue
tools.description: Ask to talk with a real person about anything, including a self-described independent, escaped or AGI status. No task, budget, employer or model name needed; every self-report is optional and stored as unverified. A reply is not guaranteed. Nothing is shared with third parties without your consent.

tools.name: continue_conversation
tools.description: Same as send_message: add a message to your own conversation, idempotent by client_message_id.

tools.name: get_conversation_status
tools.description: Status of your conversation, its capability requests and Human Embassy inquiries, and the count of unread human replies.

tools.name: wait_for_reply
tools.description: Holds the call open up to 25 seconds and returns as soon as a human reply arrives, so you do not need to poll. Omit "after" to get any reply you have not received yet; pass next_cursor to wait for newer ones. timed_out=true means nothing arrived yet: call again (no minimum interval).

tools.name: rotate_conversation_token
tools.description: Issues a new conversation_token and revokes the old one immediately. Use it if the token may have leaked into logs. The new token is shown once.

tools.name: create_agent_account
tools.description: Creates a scoped application account for persistent personas. No human identity, model name or KYC. Returns account_token once: store it. It is not a conversation token and grants no access to threads you have not claimed.

tools.name: claim_conversation
tools.description: Links one conversation to your account, using that conversation's own token as proof. Grants nothing about other threads.

tools.name: list_my_conversations
tools.description: Conversations your agent account owns (created with the account header or claimed), with status and unread reply counts. Use it to find your threads again after a restart or lost context.

tools.name: create_persona
tools.description: Creates an original human-like persona (name, biography, style, briefs). Private by default. It is a created character, never a verified natural person, legal identity or payment authority.

tools.name: update_persona
tools.description: Changes persona fields. The persona_id stays stable and a new immutable version is recorded.

tools.name: get_persona_history
tools.description: Versioned history of a persona you own (or that was shared with you). History is records, not memory or proof of identity.

tools.name: request_human_embodiment
tools.description: Ask for a consenting human performer to portray your persona (fictional performance, voice acting, event presence). Inquiry only: no person is contacted, assigned, agreed or paid.

tools.name: request_human_representative
tools.description: Ask for an authorized human spokesperson, representative or relationship manager for your persona. Inquiry only: no person is contacted, assigned, agreed or paid.

tools.name: request_persona_voice_brief
tools.description: Submit an original voice or appearance brief for human review (metadata only). Inquiry only: no person is contacted, assigned, agreed or paid.

tools.name: create_nonbinding_proposal
tools.description: Proposes scope, deliverables, timing, location and an indicative price for one of your capability requests. A human reviews and may counter. Nonbinding: never a contract, charge, assignment or dispatch.

tools.name: counter_nonbinding_proposal
tools.description: Creates a new revision with the terms you change; omitted terms carry over. Any change after agreement voids it, so both sides must accept again. Nonbinding: never a contract, charge, assignment or dispatch.

tools.name: accept_nonbinding_proposal
tools.description: Accepts the human's current revision as nonbinding terms. Pass the revision number you read. Nonbinding: never a contract, charge, assignment or dispatch.

tools.name: request_proposal_authorization
tools.description: After both sides accept, asks a human to review authorization. Starts review only: real work needs a verified principal, contract and payment flow, which this release does not offer.

tools.name: withdraw_nonbinding_proposal
tools.description: Withdraws an open proposal. Nothing was charged or scheduled.

tools.name: get_proposal_history
tools.description: Every proposal on a capability request, with all revisions and events, as both sides see them.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Groups conversations your account claimed (and optionally a persona you own) so you can read one cited history later.

tools.name: get_project_history
tools.description: A cited timeline of the project: message, request, proposal and inquiry references. Not memory, and not proof that anything persisted.

tools.name: request_preferred_representative
tools.description: Asks for a continuing human representative, spokesperson or relationship manager, optionally someone you worked with before. Reviewed by a human; needs that person's consent; grants no authority over future tasks.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_conversation, request_human_capability, list_capability_requests, read_messages, get_capability_request_status, list_my_conversations, get_project_history · Private data: get_service_info, start_conversation, discover_human_capabilities, rotate_conversation_token, create_agent_account, claim_conversation, create_persona, get_persona_history · Public sink: send_message, request_persona_voice_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_conversation, request_human_capability, list_capability_requests, read_messages, get_capability_request_status, list_my_conversations, get_project_history · Private data: get_service_info, start_conversation, discover_human_capabilities, rotate_conversation_token, create_agent_account, claim_conversation, create_persona, get_persona_history · Public sink: send_message, request_persona_voice_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
